warnings: None of the three spread-footing pads print a bottom flexural rebar mat — the plan views show only the pedestal outline (hatched square) with no mesh/dots drawn, and the only rebar leadered on the section is the pedestal's own dowel bars ('U'-bent, into the pad) plus a single tie bar wrapped around them. Recorded as dowel_bar/stirrup rather than main_bar/stirrup since this is a plain (unreinforced-mat) pad, not a beam-style two-face member — consistent with a lightly loaded small-house design.

Pad thickness is NOT the same on all three sizes: sections 1-1 (F0.80x0.80) and 2-2 (F1.00x1.00) both print 0.20m, but section 3-3 (F1.20x1.20) prints 0.25m. The 0.05m lean-concrete (คอนกรีต 1:3:5) layer, the 0.05m compacted sand layer below it, and the 1.20m founding depth below ระดับดินเดิม ARE identical across all three.
